title: "Haye Sham e Ghariban"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"

---

din dhala to rulaane ko shaam aagayi

zulm zainab pe dhaane ko shaam aagayi

sab ko bichde huwe yaad aane lagay

phir dukhe dil dukhane ko shaam aagayi

din dhala to rulaane…

sooni godh ujhdi maang aur at-ash ki sada

sab ka sabr aazmane ko shaam aagyi

din dhala to rulaane…

kaun rokay na akbar na abbas hai

sheh ke qaimay jalane ko shaam aagayi

din dhala to rulaane…

aa rahe hai sakina ki jaanib adoo

kya tamache lagane ko shaam aagayi

din dhala to rulaane…

koi aaya na laashon pe ronay ko jab

khud hi aansoo bahane ko shaam aagayi

din dhala to rulaane…

saamne hai nazeer ek jalta makaan

kya bataun zamane ko shaam aagayi

din dhala to rulaane…

from pathlib import Path

    verses[index] = line[0].upper() + line[1:]

Reconstructed the Urdu body of [ہائے شامِ غریباں](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/1/workspaces/64d2cacc69794fad9c06c830753ac613/src/data/lyrics/haye-sham-e-ghariban-nw-fe86a259fe97.md). Preserved all 20 Roman verse lines in `romanLyrics`, with capitalization updated, and checked that both editions have the same two-line opening, six numbered stanzas, and refrain placements.

Set the direction to `rtl` and removed the `noUrdu` tag. Read the closing takhallus “Nazeer” as `نظیر` and used `ہیں` in `آ رہے ہیں`, while retaining `hai` in the Roman transcription.
